rows.en: Oh, you're early today too.
Hey, I'm not late ALL the time, you know!

Ahaha, sorry, sorry.
Well, shall we get going?
Ahh, cake really is soooo good!
Uh, is it... okay for you to eat that...?

Oh, um... well...
I'll... try hard starting tomorrow...
I see. Well, then I guess it's fine.
(Akimizu really can't resist sweets, huh...)

(I was supposed to go to "Silver Moon" with
Yuu again today, but...)
rows.notes: Female; twin of c15154 (past tense in the Japanese).

I see. Then no problem!
I'm having more too!
(Yuu really can't resist sweets, huh...)

(Today I've got research to do in the library...
Akimizu's going to help me,
so let's get it done quickly.)

Okay, looks like Akimizu isn't here yet,
so I'll kill a little time...
Let's see, any interesting books...

"The Mystery of Fold: Can You Reach the Edge
of the Galaxy?" We covered some of it in class,
but it looks interesting.
What else... let's see.

"What Is Chiba Sound? The Menace of Song Energy!"
I've kind of heard of it, but Song Energy...?
rows.notes: x2, player. Chiba-song (the Song Energy unit named after Dr. Chiba) not in the glossary; 'Chiba Sound' assumed. The title says kyoui 'threat'; possibly a typo for 'wonder', kept literal.

rows.en: Hm?! What's this!

"Janice Merin: Exploring Her Allure"
Um, if I remember right, Miranda in the
Performing Arts Course is her...
rows.notes: x2, player; trails off before the relation (Miranda's...). Janice Merin and Miranda (Miranda Merin, Macross Frontier actress) not in the glossary.

rows.en:
Yep, they really do have all sorts of books here.
Huh? Akimizu, you were already here?
Uh-huh, I see, I see...

Mm-hm, mm-hm, I see,
exercise rather than food...
Whaaat~ This has THAT many calories...?
Akimizu? Akimizu-saaan? Miss Akimizuuu~?

Okay, if I work hard at this and this
starting tomorrow...
Eek! Um, yes?

So you were already here.
What were you reading?
Huh?! Ummm, this is~...

It sounded like you were saying something
about "calories"...

Oh, look, the research!
Shall we hurry up and get it done?
Huh? Oh, sure, okay then...

Phew... That was quicker than I expected.
Or rather, it's all thanks to you, Akimizu.
You know where everything is in the library.

Oh, yeah, Claire-senpai's taught me all sorts...
She says, "A real operator has to know
plenty beyond what's taught in class!"

Wow~ You're really studious...
So what were you reading earlier?

Huh?! That was... ummm...
a book about health, I guess...

Oh, that's important.
Being healthy is what lets you take on anything.

Mm, right, right! Exactly!
Health is sooo important!
I'd love to read it too. What's it called?
Mm, huh? Ahh, what was it called again...
Didn't you just put it in your bag?
Ah, hey, Akimizu!
(Did I put Akimizu on the spot a little?)

Akimizu said she'd help,
so let's get right to it.)
Oh, \p-kun, you're late!
Huh? Akimizu, you're early.
Hee hee, I have my moments too, you know!
Uh, sorry, I guess...
Phew, we're finally done.
Seriously, it's all thanks to you, Akimizu.

Huh? Oh, not at all.
Flattering me won't get you anything, you know.
Aw, too bad!
(Akimizu's really reliable at times like this.)
